answer: An identity earns its seat through Certified football referee licence with football association endorsement, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 504 aliases would need 504 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The violet sits in the mechanism itself, the crystal sits in the price of faking it, and the vertex sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
